Drop the block. Keep the tower standing.

Tottertop is a quick physics game for your phone. A crane swings above a wobbling tower: tap once to drop the block and try to stack it so the tower stays balanced. One round takes about a minute.

Contact

Coming soon. The game is still in development: there is no store page or release date yet, and details may change.

One tap

Time one tap to drop the block from the swinging crane. No menus, no tutorial walls.

Watch it wobble

See how the tower leans and sways, work out why it wobbles, and plan where the next block goes.

A minute a round

Short rounds fit any pause, whether you are waiting for a bus or taking a break.

At a glance

  • Simple physics stacking game, single player.
  • One tap to play; a round lasts about one minute.
  • Planned as free to play, supported by rewarded ads you choose to watch, with an optional purchase to remove ads.
  • Planned for iOS and Android, in 12 languages.
  • No release date yet.
